'''Transfer Force''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that allowed the user to transfer part of their life force to a mortally wounded individual, thereby saving the recipient's life. [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] using the power had to have knowledge of the Control and Alter skills.<ref name="RPG" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on the [[Mission to Mortis/Legends|Mission to Mortis]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was used as a conduit when the [[Daughter/Legends|Daughter]], who was dying, transferred the remainder of her life force to revive a deceased [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].<ref name="Altar">{{TCW|Altar of Mortis (episode)}}</ref> Sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used Transfer Force to heal [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]].<ref name="RPG" />
